scientific_display_findings: All follow-up coverage points and Wilson endpoints were checked against independent closed-form count references for every method, parameter and CV, separately for all-R operational and interval-valid conditional denominators.

Joint point/interval availability uses one parameter copy after count-consistency checks. Failure bars are the disjoint R-minus-point-valid and point-valid-minus-interval-valid counts, never tripled across parameter rows.

All72 paired-floor rows and all71 input fields are retained. Every bias, coverage and RMSE-ratio series and its saved interval endpoints were checked, including out-of-order input tables and all four CV cells.
Theta/sigma bias differences use saved relative-bias differences multiplied by100; mu uses absolute bias differences. The practical per-variant bias criterion is explicitly not applied to a contrast.

Literal errors A=(1,2,4), B=(2,1,3) on common S=3 yield bias difference1/3 with MCSE2/3 and ratio sqrt(3/2) with log-MCSE5/28. The displayed asymmetric log-delta endpoints match these references and differ from a symmetric ratio interval.

Operational coverage uses all R pairs, including unavailable intervals as noncoverage. Literal d=(0,1,-1,0,-1) yields mean-0.2 and MCSEsqrt(0.14); d=(1,1,1,1,-1) yields0.6 with MCSE0.4 and an upper normal-MC bound above1. The plot retains that bound beyond100 percentage points.

S=0 and undefined quantities remain NA gaps; S=1 retains a defined point with no fabricated uncertainty. A zero numerator RMSE ratio is labelled0 off the log curve rather than replaced with an epsilon or unity. Shared CV0 ratios remain1 with zero defined paired uncertainty, not independent-sample uncertainty.

Spacing plots use one source summary per physical variant, with R available values. Mean path minimum is distinguished from global minimum; source means and saved MCSE endpoints are unaltered. Negative normal-MC lower limits remain visible on a signed scale. K=999 transitions is explicit for n=1000 observations; realized CV remains in the complete table.

All epsilon variants are explicitly paired through shared source randomness; CV0 is the exactly identical negative control. Zero observed high-CV variation is not claimed to prove population equality.
Categorical CV positions are explicitly labelled equally spaced design cells. Pointwise intervals are not presented as simultaneous guarantees or a continuous universal boundary.

The actual four saved-floor figures were inspected at the figure_bytes serialization boundary against saved CSV values before PNG/PDF creation; the focused reference capture therefore verifies integrated loader-to-image quantity routing, not only pure-builder helpers.

Stored-profile and stored-full markers remain distinct and use their saved extended differences in the correct profile representation. The Brownian-with-free-drift and iid limits, saved resolution, cap-limited tail status and finite-search limitations remain explicit.

All four registered diagnostic steps and all three adjacent-pair identities are retained. Artist coordinates were checked against every saved eigenvalue, condition, score and relative/whitened discrepancy trace, including exact zero, negative eigenvalues and unavailable inverse-based diagnostics.

The registered h/2 matrix is labelled a candidate subject to all original gates. h/4 and h/8 are diagnostic only. The original accepted or rejected interval status is retained; no fit, interval or covariance is replaced.

Float64/longdouble Hessian ladders are labelled as sharing the same registered float64-normalized representation, distinct from the separately normalized longdouble profile. Saved63 fraction bits,64 significant binary digits and16 storage bytes are shown without a quadruple-precision claim.

A retained original-replay failure produces six explicitly unavailable panels, not zero numerical diagnostics. Independent engineering tests cover closed literal review-required selected archives; they do not certify a successful original E2 replay.

resolved_roundoff_defect.issue: An exact saved min<=mean<=max display preflight can reject a legitimate binary64 mean of2000 identical small floor values by one or a few ulps.
resolved_roundoff_defect.independent_regression: np.full(2000,5e-9), np.full(2000,5e-7) and np.full(2000,5e-5) produce means above their identical extrema on the reviewed platform. The full12-cell literal spacing table is accepted with every saved mean and computed MCSE byte unchanged.
resolved_roundoff_defect.allowance: gamma_(R+1)*max(abs(min),abs(max)), with gamma_m=(m*eps)/(1-m*eps), binary64 eps. This conservative bound uses eps, twice unit roundoff, solely for display consistency.
resolved_roundoff_defect.negative_controls: Mean deviations of plus/minus1e-8 relative still reject; exact zero extrema receive no positive absolute tolerance and reject a nonzero mean.
